lines.zh: 我贴着树冠滑过去，翼尖擦叶。
lines.en: I skim the canopy, wingtips brushing leaves.

lines.zh: 两排小牙在长嘴里咔咔响。
lines.en: Two rows of small teeth click in my long jaw.
I hop first, then open my wings.
The cliff wind lifts me.
I fly low along the river, hunting fish.
Short wings flap fast and loud.
I land on a branch; it dips under me.

lines.zh: 日光正盛，是我活动的时候。
lines.en: The sun is high, my working hours.
I bank away from a trunk.

lines.zh: 爪子收起来，我叫了一声。
lines.en: Claws tucked, I give a call.

lines.zh: 向上的气流，我借来爬升。
lines.en: I borrow the updraft to climb.

lines.zh: 落回地面时，我先蹦两下。
lines.en: Back on the ground, I hop twice.

lines.zh: 这片林子太密，飞得低些。
lines.en: This wood is thick; I keep low.

lines.zh: 我在石头上歇了一下再走。
lines.en: I rest on a rock, then move on.
I hang in the tree, wings half spread.

lines.zh: 我用喙理了理胸前的绒毛。
lines.en: I groom my chest with my beak.
Head to one side, then back.
A breeze and I rock gently.
My eyes blink, two black beans.
That fish was too slippery; it got away.
I shift my grip on the branch.

lines.zh: 树叶的影子在我背上走。
lines.en: Leaf shadows walk across my back.
The sky is clear, no hawks.
I pull my neck in; it's a bit cold.
I know this area; no need to look.
I wait for the clouds to clear.
The taste of fish lingers in my mouth.
I flap once to test the wind.

lines.zh: 你比我高很多，我不习惯。
lines.en: You are much taller than I'm used to.
I look at you with one eye.
You reach out; I retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很长，其实不厉害。
lines.en: My jaw is long, but it's not much.
You hold still, so I risk a look.
I tilt my head; you are not a tree.

lines.zh: 你的影子压住了我的枝。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my branch.
I have wings; I can leave anytime.
I sniff: you are not a fish.
I call again; hear it.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我的时候，我在上面。
lines.en: While you search, I am above you.
Should I fly off? Still deciding.

lines.zh: 我短促地叫了一下，翅一抖。
lines.en: A short cry, and my wing jerks.
My wing gives and I drop.
Pain opens my claws wide.

lines.zh: 我缩起一只翼，护住身体。
lines.en: I fold one wing to shield myself.
I can still fly with this.
Two flaps and I steady myself.
Feathers scatter on the ground.
I retreat to a branch, away from you.
You're far too strong for me.
I pant; my chest rises fast.
A fishy smell; my wings tense.

lines.zh: 你抬高手，我更想落过去。
lines.en: Raise it higher and I want to land there.
I circle once before deciding to land.
I know raw fish when I smell it.
I land on your arm to try.
Don't grab me; I spook easily.

lines.zh: 它在我嘴里，尾巴还在动。
lines.en: It's in my mouth and the tail still moves.
I'll take a bite and go.
Held that high, I cannot reach it.
This smell makes me circle you twice.
Your shoulder clips my wing.
I flop back to the ground, undignified.
Mind the wing; it bends too easily.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你的袖子，轻飘飘。
lines.en: I brush past your sleeve, weightless.
Bump me and I go up.
I spiral down from the hit.
I swerve around your head.
I stumble on landing.
This body is too small to take hits.
I flap off your hat and away.

lines.zh: 我飞到她的枝头，收好翅膀。
lines.en: I fly to her branch and fold my wings.
Both our heads tilt together.
She calls; I answer.
We split this cliff face between us.
I offer her the fish I just caught.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，像两片叶。
lines.en: We stand side by side like two leaves.

lines.zh: 她被我翅膀挡了一下，没生气。
lines.en: My wing bumps her; she doesn't mind.
She flies first; I follow.

lines.zh: 我们绕着崖盘旋了好几圈。
lines.en: We circle the cliff several times.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等她落在我旁边。
lines.en: I stop and wait for her to land beside me.
A bit of dried fish; I take it.
This twig will line a nest.
Something glinted, very light.
I close my claws around it.
Too heavy; I can't lift it.
My mouth is too small to grip it.
A bright chip fell at my feet.
I hide it in a tree hollow.
It wriggles; I let go.
I pick the smallest piece.

lines.zh: 水里那条影子我看见了。
lines.en: I see the dark shape in the water.
I fix on the water and drop a wingtip first.
A small fish jumps; perfect.
I fix on its dorsal fin.
The wind is right; I come down with it.

lines.zh: 我不急着落，先看它跑哪。
lines.en: No rush to land; first see where it goes.
Not much of a meal, but edible.
I come out from behind the trees.
It heads for the shallows; good.
The claws go out first.
I pick my landing spot, half a block off.

lines.zh: 它一转方向，我也跟着转。
lines.en: It turns; so do I.
This time I'll hold on.
My wingtip cuts the water into ripples.
I fly above it, keeping pace.
When it surfaces, I close in.
I circle twice, looking for an opening.
Its shadow is clear beneath the water.

lines.zh: 我的小牙已经准备好了。
lines.en: My little teeth are ready.
The wind pushes me off a little.
A little lower, a little closer.
It wants to sink; I won't allow it.
I wheel over the shallows.

lines.zh: 翅膀有点酸，但我等得起。
lines.en: My wings ache, but I can wait.
This fish is wary.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度，从头上来。
lines.en: I change angle and come from above.
The water breaks; now.
I come down almost silently.
It is right beneath my claws.

lines.zh: 我一爪抓下去，水花溅开。
lines.en: I strike with a claw; water sprays.
The long jaw snaps shut; got it.
I can't lift it; it's too heavy.
I peck twice in a row.
My claw rakes the water and misses.
I pin it in the shallows.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，尾巴不摆了。
lines.en: One bite and the tail stops moving.
I haul it flapping toward the bank.
Small teeth can't pierce; I can only shake.
It thrashes; I adjust my grip.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，又掉了下来。
lines.en: I bite, and it drops again.
On the second try I bite true.

lines.zh: 连着水的重量，我快撑不住。
lines.en: With the water's weight, I'm losing hold.
I tip my head and swallow it whole.
A new nest appears on the cliff.
I emerge from the canopy.

lines.zh: 第一缕晨光，我拍翅上升。
lines.en: First light, and I flap upward.
The river is wide, room to fly.
I call once by way of hello.

lines.zh: 脚下是软泥，我落了下来。
lines.en: Soft mud below; I come down.

lines.zh: 风里有鱼味，是个好兆头。
lines.en: Fish on the wind; a good sign.
I shake the dew off my wings.
These trees are taller than I expected.
I make one circuit of the wood.
The rock cleft is just wide enough.
I perch on the highest branch.
Sky first, ground next, then you.
No one here knows me.
I twitch my tail and stand up straight.

lines.zh: 阳光很好，我伸了个懒腰。
lines.en: Good sun; I stretch.

lines.zh: 昨天我还在另一片河岸。
lines.en: Yesterday I was on another bank.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上跑得比我还快。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground outruns me.

lines.zh: 火苗一碰，我的翼尖就焦了。
lines.en: Flame touches me and my wingtip scorches.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，翅膀折向一边。
lines.en: I hit the ground with one wing bent wrong.
The water closes over me; I beat at it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得翻了好几圈。
lines.en: The blast spins me over and over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿透了我的翼膜。
lines.en: An arrow punches through my wing.

lines.zh: 怪力抓住我，翅膀不听使唤。
lines.en: Strange force grips me; my wings won't obey.
Too hungry to keep my grip on the branch.

lines.zh: 雷电劈过，我浑身发麻往下掉。
lines.en: Lightning passes; numb, I drop.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有底的暗处，翅膀很沉。
lines.en: I fall into bottomless dark; my wings are heavy.
